cohort: 76 patients who delivered by cesarean section at a single university between January 1, 2013 and June 30, 2020 and whose placentas were pathologically assessed
finding: Patients with chronic deciduitis had a significantly higher rate of preeclampsia and worse perinatal outcomes, including earlier gestational age at birth, lower birth weight, higher rate of late fetal death, lower Apgar scores, and lower umbilical artery pH.
gest_age: Earlier gestational age in the CD group (p=0.040)
birth_weight: Lower birth weight in the CD group (p=0.001)
